top_signals.title: Ex-Banker Eyeing Top WHO Job Says Agency Can Tap Outside Money
top_signals.summary: The World Health Organization should look beyond its own budget for funds to support itself and member countries, according to Indonesia’s Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin, who is seeking to lead the agency.

top_signals.title: Merz’s conservatives set to crash out of German state parliament
top_signals.summary: The German Chancellor's Christian Democratic Union won 4.9% of the vote on Sunday — the far-right AfD party won with 38.3%.
